findings.subject: navigation-menu
findings.summary: NavigationMenuLink has no focus ring: `outline: none` with only a muted background on :focus-visible, which disappears under forced colors; the current link shares the same fill as hover/focus.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/navigation-menu/navigation-menu.css:204-231 (outline: none at :217; :focus-visible,[data-active] { background: var(--a63-surface-muted) } at :223-226); no forced-colors block in the file; styles/reset.css has no focus-visible fallback; AGENTS.md rule 12.
findings.fix: Give .a63-NavigationMenu-link:focus-visible the control focus-ring outline with a negative offset (as the trigger does at :90-94); draw [data-active] with a distinct marker (weight or an inline-start/underline bar) separate from hover; add a forced-colors block (focus outline in Highlight, active link in Highlight/HighlightText) and add navigation-menu to recipes.test.ts forced-colors list.

verified.reason: navigation-menu.css:217 sets outline:none on .a63-NavigationMenu-link and :223-226 gives :focus-visible and [data-active] the same surface-muted background, which hover also uses (:227-231). The file has no forced-colors block, so under forced colors the focused link has no indicator. This also breaks AGENTS.md rule 12 (focus rings must be outlines).

verified.reason: Reproduced: `pnpm -s atom63 component menu` returns component.not_found. menu.json is stable with tones [neutral, primary]. The gap is real, but the CLI points builders to the real components (dropdown-menu, context-menu, menubar) and tone is an opt-in extra, so the default use is not blocked.

findings.subject: dropdown-menu
findings.summary: DropdownMenu, ContextMenu and Menubar baselines show only closed triggers; open and submenu-open from the real components are never captured.
findings.evidence: ui-react-dropdownmenu-submenu-chromium-linux.png and -themes (trigger only); ui-react-contextmenu-with-sub-and-checkables-chromium-linux.png (target only); ui-react-menubar-themes/-playground (closed bar).
findings.fix: Render these stories with defaultOpen (and an open submenu) for the visual project, or capture after a play() that opens them.

findings.subject: menu
findings.summary: The submenu chevron in DropdownMenu, ContextMenu and Menubar does not mirror in RTL.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/menu/menu.css:170-175 (no dir=rtl rule); ChevronRightIcon dropdown-menu.tsx:60-72, 271-273; breadcrumb mirrors its chevron at breadcrumb.css:66-68.
findings.fix: Add `:where([dir='rtl']) .a63-Menu-sub-icon svg { transform: scaleX(-1) }` to menu.css.

findings.subject: pagination
findings.summary: Pagination's Previous/Next chevrons do not mirror in RTL, and their visible labels and the ellipsis sr text are hard-coded English that consumers cannot replace.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/pagination/pagination.tsx:79-87, 95-103 (children set after the props spread), :119-120 ('More pages'); pagination.css has no RTL rule.
findings.fix: Mirror the chevrons under dir=rtl; let children (or `label`/`srLabel` props) replace the default text and aria-label on Previous, Next and Ellipsis.

findings.subject: pagination
findings.summary: Pagination has no disabled state for Previous on the first page or Next on the last page.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-foundation/contracts/components/pagination.json states ['rest','current']; pagination.tsx:52-105 renders <a> with no aria-disabled/disabled handling.
findings.fix: Add a `disabled` state to the contract and PaginationLink (aria-disabled, no href, Button disabled styling), with a story and baseline.

findings.subject: breadcrumb
findings.summary: BreadcrumbEllipsis has a fixed English sr label 'More' that cannot be localized, and long segments only wrap with no truncation option.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.tsx:118-126 (children after props spread); breadcrumb.css:10,20.
findings.fix: Accept children or a `label` prop for the sr text; add an opt-in max-inline-size + ellipsis truncation on BreadcrumbLink/Page with a long-string story.

findings.subject: tabs
findings.summary: Tabs stay 32px tall on coarse pointers (only min-width reaches 44px); the alignment check records this as a deliberate exception that YZ has not accepted against the bar's 44px rule.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/tabs/tabs.css:133; scripts/design-system/check-control-alignment.mjs:118-146 ('Tabs tab', expected 32, 'scrolling tab list clips an overhanging pseudo').
findings.fix: YZ decides: accept the declared exception (iOS segmented/tab rows at ~32pt) for the bar, or raise tab rendered height on touch to --a63-control-min-target.

findings.subject: context-menu
findings.summary: ContextMenu has no keyboard or pattern check, so the non-pointer path to its actions is unverified.
findings.evidence: apps/storybook/a11y/patterns.test.ts:55-100 binds dropdown-menu and tabs only from this batch.
findings.fix: Bind context-menu to the menu pattern (opened via Shift+F10) in patterns.test.ts.

findings.subject: context-menu
findings.summary: ContextMenu, Menubar and NavigationMenu CLI answers carry two boilerplate guidance bullets shared across navigation components and no keyboard or phone guidance; none has a docs page.
findings.evidence: `pnpm -s atom63 component context-menu|menubar|navigation-menu` guidance: 'Preserve link, menu, command, or selection semantics...' and 'Expose current location when applicable...' repeated verbatim; apps/docs/src/pages has only component-dropdown-menu.mdx and component-tabs.mdx from this batch.
findings.fix: Write component-specific guidance (menubar keyboard model, context-menu touch/keyboard alternative, navigation-menu link vs trigger and phone behaviour) in the docs catalog and regenerate the index.

findings.subject: command
findings.summary: The command dialog viewport ignores safe areas and uses a fixed 26rem popup height on phones.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/command/command.css:25-38 (padding max(1rem, 4vh), no safe-area inset), :51 (max-height: 26rem).
findings.fix: Add --a63-safe-area-* insets to the viewport padding and cap the popup with the dynamic viewport height on small screens.

findings.subject: navigation-menu
findings.summary: The navigation panel's visual quality cannot be judged: no theme matrix shows it open.
findings.evidence: ui-react-navigationmenu-themes-chromium-linux.png (8 closed trigger rows only).
findings.fix: Add an open panel to the Themes story so the contact sheet shows it (same fix as finding 15).

findings.subject: command
findings.summary: Command nests a bordered panel inside a bordered popup; in retro it reads as a double frame.
findings.evidence: command.css:53 (popup border) and :130-138 (panel border + shadow); ui-react-command-themes-chromium-linux.png retro light/dark; AGENTS.md rule 7.
findings.fix: YZ to confirm on the contact sheet; if kept, drop the panel border where the theme already draws a panel shadow.

findings.subject: breadcrumb
findings.summary: In terminal, the current page takes the accent colour while links are navy, so the non-link looks like the most clickable item.
findings.evidence: ui-react-breadcrumb-themes-chromium-linux.png terminal light/dark rows ('Atom63' in accent).
findings.fix: YZ to confirm; otherwise give .a63-Breadcrumb-page text-primary in terminal like other themes.

findings.subject: menu
findings.summary: The static menu gallery draws the radio item with a Circle icon, but the shipped RadioItem renders a check, so the baseline does not show the real radio state.
findings.evidence: menu.stories.tsx:56 (Circle) vs dropdown-menu.tsx:192-194 and menubar.tsx:172-175 (check icon).
findings.fix: Use the same check indicator in the gallery (or change RadioItem to a dot if that is the intent).

findings.subject: dropdown-menu
findings.summary: DropdownMenuCheckboxItem and RadioItem lack the `inset` prop that MenubarCheckboxItem and MenubarRadioItem have.
findings.evidence: dropdown-menu.tsx:158-200 vs menubar.tsx:126-180.
findings.fix: Add `inset` to the DropdownMenu and ContextMenu checkbox/radio items for parity.

findings.subject: menubar
findings.summary: The menubar recipe header points at a nonexistent a63-DropdownMenu-* recipe.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/menubar/menubar.css:6-8 (the shared recipe is a63-Menu-* in menu/menu.css).
findings.fix: Correct the comment to the a63-Menu-* recipe.
